Package ed.inf.adbs.blazedb.entity

Class Tuple

java.lang.Object
ed.inf.adbs.blazedb.entity.Tuple
public class Tuple extends Object
The Tuple class represents a row of data, typically retrieved from a database table. It stores the column names and their corresponding values in a structured manner, allowing for efficient access and manipulation.

      public Tuple(List<String> row, String tableName)
      Constructs a new Tuple object from a list of row values and a table name. This constructor is typically used when creating tuples from scan operations.

      row - The list of string representations of the row values.
      tableName - The name of the table from which the row was retrieved.
